claims: Rory McIlroy's net worth is estimated to be approximately $250 million to $330 million as of early 2026.
As of early 2026, Rory McIlroy has earned over $110 million on the PGA Tour.
As of early 2026, Rory McIlroy has earned over €60 million ($68 million) on the DP World Tour.
Rory McIlroy's major sponsors include Nike, TaylorMade, Omega, and UnitedHealth Group.
Rory McIlroy's Nike contract was valued at roughly $250 million over 10 years.
Rory McIlroy co-founded TMRW Sports with Tiger Woods.
Rory McIlroy operates an investment firm, Symphony Ventures.
Symphony Ventures has invested in Whoop.
Symphony Ventures has invested in GolfPass.
Symphony Ventures has invested in Puttery.
In 2023, Rory McIlroy was ranked the second highest-paid golfer.
In 2023, Rory McIlroy earned $38 million on the course.
In 2023, Rory McIlroy earned $45 million off the course.
Rory McIlroy has won four major championships.
Rory McIlroy has won three FedEx Cup titles
